title: The Nobel Prize in Chemistry
The Nobel Prize in Chemistry
deck: 回看授奖之前的候选人与研究领域预测。
Candidate and research-field forecasts before the award.
about: 这一专题保留既有的年度档案、真实得主、候选人的研究方向和所属机构。各平台分别展示，个人预测与领域预测明确区分。
This topic retains the annual archive, actual laureates, candidate research and affiliations. Sources and individual versus field predictions remain distinct.
questions: 当时哪些人或研究方向受到关注？
Which people or fields attracted attention?
不同平台如何判断，最终结果是什么？
How did sources differ, and what happened?

title: 全固态电池
Solid-state batteries
deck: 成分验证、样品生产与客户交付，各自需要什么证据？
Composition tests, sample production and customer delivery require different evidence.
about: “固态”描述电解质体系，并不直接回答电芯中是否含锂、能量密度有多高，或是否已进入量产。本专题把检测指标与工程事件分开。涉及 Donut Lab 的题目反映各自创建者的规则；受委托的测试结果只覆盖报告实际测量的项目。

Solid-state refers to the electrolyte system; it does not establish lithium content, energy density or production readiness. This topic separates measurements from engineering milestones. Commissioned testing covers the measurements actually reported.
questions: 被测电池能否与商品或交付样品对应？
Can the tested cell be linked to the product?
电芯指标、电池包指标和整车表现有没有混用？
Are cell, pack and vehicle measures being conflated?
宣布产能、开始生产、实际交付分别到了哪一步？
What is announced capacity, operating production or delivery?

title: 如何比较不同电池测试
Comparing battery tests
body: 能量密度要说明测的是活性材料、电芯还是整包，以及质量和体积的分母。快充测试还需同时查看温度、充电区间、倍率及循环后的容量保持；单次充电时间无法代表长期寿命。

Energy density needs a material, cell or pack boundary and a mass or volume denominator. Fast-charge comparisons need temperature, state-of-charge range, rate and capacity retention; a single charging time is not lifetime.

title: 从送样到客户交付
From samples to delivery
body: 材料检测、电芯送样、客户认证、产线调试与零售交付是不同阶段。企业公告中的目标年份应作为当时的计划阅读，完成情况以具体产品、批次和客户记录为准。
Materials testing, cell samples, qualification, commissioning and retail delivery are different stages. Announced years are targets; completion needs product, batch and customer records.

title: 界面阻抗与循环寿命
Interface impedance and cycle life
body: 固态界面需要保持接触并控制副反应。高能量密度结果应与堆压、温度、循环倍率、面容量和终止条件一起阅读；此处不从单次放电结果推算长期循环寿命。

Solid interfaces need sustained contact and controlled side reactions. Energy results require pressure, temperature, rate, areal capacity and endpoint context; single-discharge results do not establish cycle lifetime.

title: 继续查阅其他电池体系
Other battery chemistries
body: 新增钠离子及动力电池与规模储能专题，单独讨论载流离子、正极份额、单体性能、整包成本和液流电解液。不同体系按各自来源和测试条件查阅。
New sodium-ion and EV/grid-storage topics separately cover charge carriers, cathode share, cells, pack costs and flow electrolytes under their own source conditions.

label: DL6 电芯质量比能量
DL6 cell specific energy
scope: 单个客户送检电芯；+25 °C、0.1C、第二次放电。
One submitted cell; +25 °C, 0.1C, second discharge.

label: DL6 电芯体积能量密度
DL6 volumetric energy density
scope: 与质量比能量为同一测试；不代表整包或批量寿命。
Same cell test; not pack performance or production lifetime.

label: 送检组分锂含量
Submitted-parts lithium
scope: ICP-OES；一个电芯的送检组分，不含外包装。
ICP-OES on submitted parts from one cell, excluding pouch.

label: 送检组分钠含量
Submitted-parts sodium
scope: 元素含量不能单独确定电解质或储能机理。
Elemental content alone does not identify electrolyte or storage mechanism.

title: 室温超导
Room-temperature superconductors
deck: 从独立复现实验，到常压器件的商业应用。
From independent replication to commercial ambient-pressure devices.
about: 零电阻、磁响应、相变和样品成分共同构成核对线索，悬浮视频本身不足以替代完整表征。LK-99 的历史题目还展示了“有人做了复现实验”“实验支持超导”和“商品采用超导体”之间的区别。这里保留各题不同的温度、压力、时间边界和取消状态。

Zero resistance, magnetic response, transitions and sample composition need joint review; levitation alone is insufficient. LK-99 contracts distinguish replication attempts, successful replication and commercial adoption. Contract-specific definitions and cancellations remain visible.
questions: 题目要求的是实验发表，还是成功复现？
Does the contract ask for publication or successful replication?
室温与常压的数值范围如何定义？
How are temperature and pressure defined?
条件市场的前提失败后，是 No 还是取消？
Does a failed condition mean No or cancellation?

title: 判断超导需要哪些测量
Measurements for superconductivity
body: 电阻下降需要与磁性测量、样品组成及测量条件结合。杂相引起的输运异常或局部悬浮不能单独确立体相超导；可复现的温度、压力、磁场和临界电流是核心记录。

Resistance changes need magnetic, compositional and experimental context. Impurity-related anomalies or partial levitation alone do not establish bulk superconductivity; reproducible temperature, pressure, field and critical-current records matter.

title: 材料发现与商品应用
Materials discovery and products
body: 高温超导线材已有低温应用，室温市场则通常另有温度与压力门槛。短样、连续线材和整机产品的制造要求不同，不能把已有低温产品当作常温商业化的完成证明。
HTS conductors have cryogenic applications; ambient-temperature contracts impose different thresholds. Short samples, long tapes and complete devices also need different manufacturing evidence.

title: 碳捕集与 MOF
Carbon capture & MOFs
deck: 把材料供应、捕集过程和实际运行区分开来看。
Distinguish material supply, capture processes and operating deployment.
about: MOF 的开放孔隙可以通过节点与配体化学进行调节，但过程表现还取决于成型、湿度、再生和循环条件。BASF 与 Svante 的 CALF-20 供应合作是可查的产业资料，不等于某个装置已经实现公告中的所有目标。本次 Manifold 检索未找到可核验的 Svante、Atoco 或 MOF 专用产业事件；下列相关市场分别涉及生物分子与矿物风化，不被标成 MOF 赔率。

MOF pores are chemically tunable, while process performance also depends on shaping, humidity, regeneration and cycling. The BASF–Svante CALF-20 supply agreement is documented industrial evidence, not proof of every deployment target. This Manifold search found no verified Svante, Atoco or MOF-specific industrial contract. Related protein and mineral-weathering contracts below are not labelled MOF odds.
questions: 供应材料或建成产线，是否等于实际捕集量？
Does material supply or a factory establish captured tonnage?
捕集的 CO₂ 是否进一步储存，边界是否相同？
Is captured CO₂ stored, and are boundaries comparable?
相关预测究竟涉及哪一种材料路线？
Which material pathway does each forecast concern?

title: 捕集与净移除分别计量
Capture and net removal
body: 烟气捕集处理工业排放，直接空气捕集处理低浓度空气。永久移除还涉及能源排放、运输与封存；仅有吸附容量、设备能力或捕集量，不能直接给出净移除量。

Flue-gas capture and direct air capture treat different concentrations. Permanent removal also needs energy emissions, transport and storage accounting; capacity or gross capture alone does not give net removal.

title: MOF 的制造与运行证据
MOF manufacturing and operation
body: CALF-20 的供应合作可用于了解吸附剂如何进入制造链。材料放大之后，还需要结构化、循环再生、耐湿和装置运行资料；本专题其他路线的预测概率不代表 MOF 本身的成功率。

CALF-20 supply agreements show manufacturing integration. Scale-up additionally needs forming, cyclic regeneration, humidity resistance and plant operation; probabilities for other routes do not estimate MOF success.

label: Mammoth 名义捕集能力
Mammoth nameplate capture
scope: 设计能力，不是实测净移除或核证交付量。
Design capacity, not measured net removal or verified deliveries.

label: 启动时已安装收集模块
Collectors installed at startup
scope: 已安装 / 计划总量；只描述启动节点。
Installed / planned total; describes that historical milestone.

title: 聚变发电
Fusion power
deck: 从实验能量增益到并网供电，还隔着哪些工程环节？
From experimental gain to grid electricity: the engineering steps in between.
about: 聚变实验的能量增益、整机净发电、商业供电和电网占比是不同指标。这里分别收录 Helion 的特定交付事件与美国长期供电占比预测。
Experimental gain, net electricity, commercial delivery and grid share measure different outcomes. This topic separates a Helion delivery contract from a long-horizon US grid-share forecast.
questions: 净增益的输入和输出，在哪里计量？
Where are energy inputs and outputs measured?
购电协议中的计划，是否已有实际供电记录？
Does the purchase agreement have measured delivery records?
装机功率与年度发电量占比有什么差别？
How does capacity differ from annual generation share?

title: 从实验指标到电站指标
From experimental to plant metrics
body: 聚变电站需要持续或重复输出、净电力计量、维护与燃料供应。一次成功实验只能回答其特定工况下的问题，供电规模还要看可用率、厂用电和并网记录。

Fusion plants need repeatable output, net-electricity accounting, maintenance and fuel supply. A successful shot answers a narrower question; supply scale needs availability, auxiliary consumption and grid records.

title: 50 MW 与美国 2% 是不同事件
50 MW and 2% of US supply differ
body: 前者是特定供应商的客户交付，后者是全行业在美国供电中的份额。装机功率不等于年度发电量；长期占比题目的统计口径不足之处保留在规则核查中。
One concerns delivery by a named supplier; the other concerns an industry’s share of US electricity. Capacity differs from annual energy; missing definitions remain flagged.

title: 量子纠错计算
Error-corrected quantum computing
deck: 逻辑比特、长电路和商业可用，分别如何验证？
Logical qubits, long circuits and commercial availability require different tests.
about: 增加物理比特数量并不等于获得更多可用逻辑比特。专题围绕纠错能力、长电路运行与商业可用性整理市场规则，保留“已停盘但未判定”等原平台状态。

More physical qubits do not automatically provide more usable logical qubits. Contracts concern correction, long circuits and commercial availability; closed but unresolved records retain their source status.
questions: 实验展示的是逻辑存储还是逻辑门运算？
Does the experiment demonstrate memory or logical gates?
一亿个门的口径与第三方验证要求是什么？
How are 100 million gates defined and independently verified?
商业可用需要哪些产品和访问证据？
What product and access records establish commercial availability?

title: 纠错实验之外还需要什么
Beyond correction experiments
body: 通用容错计算还需验证逻辑门、读出、解码延迟和长电路累计错误。不同硬件路线与编码方案的资源开销不同，物理比特数、逻辑比特数和可执行门数应分别列出。

General fault-tolerant computing also needs logical gates, readout, decoding latency and accumulated circuit errors. Hardware and code overhead vary; physical qubits, logical qubits and executable gates are separate metrics.

title: 商业可用的证据
Evidence of commercial availability
body: 产品上线、付费访问条件、用户能运行的任务和独立使用记录，比路线图更接近“可用”的含义。规则没有写明的性能阈值不能由本站补造；停盘未判定的事件继续保留未判定状态。
Product access terms, runnable tasks and independent usage matter beyond roadmaps. We do not invent absent performance thresholds, and closed unresolved contracts remain unresolved.

title: 钙钛矿光伏
Perovskite photovoltaics
deck: 从首批叠层组件出货，到年度 GW 规模与全球装机份额。
From first tandem shipments to annual GW-scale sales and global deployment share.
about: 钙钛矿吸收层可以与硅电池叠层，提高光谱利用率。小面积电池效率、整块组件效率、工厂产能和实际出货是四种不同数据；本专题关注商业交付与部署规模。

A perovskite absorber can be stacked on silicon to use more of the spectrum. Small-cell efficiency, module efficiency, factory capacity and shipments are distinct; this topic follows commercial delivery and deployment.
questions: 效率记录对应电池还是完整组件？
Does the efficiency record concern a cell or a full module?
年度出货是否达到 1 GW，并附有可接受的质保？
Do annual shipments reach 1 GW with bankable warranties?
全球部署占比以哪个年度、哪个分母统计？
Which year and denominator define global deployment share?

title: 稳定性与质保
Durability and warranties
body: 光、热、湿度、偏压及其组合会影响材料和器件寿命。商业组件需要封装、户外数据、衰减模型与质保支持；较高初始效率不能替代长期发电可靠性。

Light, heat, humidity, bias and combined stress affect lifetime. Commercial modules need packaging, field data, degradation models and warranties; initial efficiency does not establish long-term reliability.

title: 如何核对 GW 级交付
Checking GW-scale delivery
body: 核对的是单一制造商在一个日历年实际商业交付的组件功率，并对照原题质保条件。计划产能、累计多年销量和试验组件应分别处理；全球部署多数则需要另一套行业统计。

Check actual commercial module power delivered by one manufacturer in one calendar year, with the contract’s warranty conditions. Planned capacity, multiyear totals and pilots differ, as does global deployment share.

title: 钠离子电池
Sodium-ion batteries
deck: 比能量、低温表现与客户交付，分开核对。
Check specific energy, cold performance and customer delivery separately.
about: 钠离子在正负极材料之间迁移完成储能；材料体系、硬碳负极和电解液会影响性能。资源与成本潜力不能自动转为更低商品价格，车型发布与实际交付也应分别记录。

Sodium-ion storage shuttles ions between electrodes. Electrode chemistry, hard carbon and electrolyte affect performance. Resource advantages do not automatically establish product prices, and launches differ from delivery.
questions: 指标对应电芯、电池包还是车辆？
Does the metric describe a cell, pack or vehicle?
低温容量、放电功率与循环寿命分别测了吗？
Are cold capacity, power and cycle life measured separately?
是否已有符合原题条件的零售客户交付？
Are there qualifying retail customer deliveries?

title: 钠离子与锂离子的材料差别
Materials differences from lithium-ion
body: 钠离子体系不能只靠“未检出锂”确认；需核对正负极物相、载流离子及电解液。产业比较还涉及压实密度、首周效率、低温性能、封装和系统质量。

Absence of lithium alone does not establish sodium-ion chemistry; verify electrode phases, charge carriers and electrolyte. Compaction, first-cycle efficiency, cold behavior, packaging and system mass also matter.

title: 为何历史市场可能给出不同结算
Why historical contracts can resolve differently
body: “有钠离子商品”“当年向付费用户交车”与“主流车企销售典型乘用车”并不相同。四个原题保留各自范围与平台结算，不合并成一个技术是否成功的结论。
A commercial sodium product, paid vehicle delivery and typical passenger-car sales by a major manufacturer differ. Each of the four contracts retains its own scope and source resolution.

title: 低温数据怎样比较
Comparing cold-performance data
body: 容量保持率需说明参照温度、倍率和截止电压；低温瞬时功率不能代替长周期容量保持。企业公告未给出的完整测试协议继续列为待核查事项。
Retention needs a reference temperature, rate and cutoff voltage. Cold peak power does not replace cycle retention, and protocols absent from company releases remain unverified.

label: Naxtra 质量比能量
Naxtra specific energy
scope: 企业披露最高值；不能直接与整包或其他工况比较。
Company-reported maximum; not directly comparable to packs or other conditions.

label: 所发布车型纯电续航
Announced vehicle range
scope: 车型级表述；页面未给出完整测试循环。
Vehicle-level claim; the release does not specify a complete test cycle.

label: −40 °C 容量保持率
Capacity retention at −40 °C
scope: 企业低温性能披露，不是常温循环寿命。
Company cold-performance claim, not ambient cycle lifetime.

title: 动力电池与规模储能
EV batteries & grid storage
deck: 从 LFP 份额、单体比能量，到电池包成本与储能规模。
From LFP share and cell energy to pack cost and grid-scale storage.
about: 这一专题将动力电池材料与电网储能分别计量。正极路线影响成本与能量密度，整包还包含结构、热管理和控制；储能项目同时需要功率、能量、效率与寿命。

This topic measures EV chemistry and grid storage separately. Cathodes affect cost and energy density, while packs add structures, thermal systems and control. Storage also needs power, energy, efficiency and lifetime.
questions: 价格按单体还是整包、额定还是可用能量计？
Does price concern a cell or pack and rated or usable energy?
LFP 份额用生产出货还是注册装车统计？
Does LFP share use production shipments or registered deployment?
储能规模是 GW 功率、GWh 能量还是实际放电量？
Is storage measured as GW, GWh or actual delivered energy?

title: 电芯与系统的分母
Cell and system boundaries
body: Wh/kg 与 Wh/L 分别描述质量和体积指标。把电芯装入电池包会增加连接、支撑和热管理，不能将单体纪录原样用于整包。成本模型也必须说明币值年份、规模和可用能量。

Wh/kg and Wh/L measure different denominators. Packs add interconnections, supports and thermal systems, so cell records do not carry over unchanged. Cost models need currency year, scale and usable-energy scope.

title: 功率、能量和时长
Power, energy and duration
body: GW 表示瞬时功率能力，GWh 表示储能量；能量除以功率得到名义时长，但不能替代实测可用时长和效率。市场设定的 130 GWh 基线属于规则常数，不被写成本站核实的历史统计。

GW measures power and GWh energy. Their ratio gives nominal duration, not verified usable duration or efficiency. The contract’s fixed 130 GWh baseline is a rule constant, not a historical statistic verified here.

title: 全钒液流与关键材料
Vanadium flow and material demand
body: 全钒液流通过不同价态电解液反应储能，储罐和电堆分别影响能量与功率。用钒份额须按钒元素含量核算，并区分电解液库存、当年消费与钢铁等其他用途。

Vanadium flow stores energy through redox couples; tanks and stacks affect energy and power differently. Consumption shares need contained-V accounting and separation of inventory, annual use and non-battery applications.

label: 电池包制造成本估计
Estimated pack manufacturing cost
scope: 轻型车电池包，可用能量口径。
Light-duty packs, usable-energy basis.

label: 电池包制造成本估计
Estimated pack manufacturing cost
scope: 假设年产至少 10 万套，非零售价格。
At least 100,000 packs/year; not retail price.

label: 全球 EV 电池部署
Global EV battery deployment
scope: IEA 行业统计；不等于工厂名义年产能。
IEA sector statistic; not factory nameplate capacity.

label: LFP 部署份额
LFP deployment share
scope: 按新注册 EV 电池容量；LFP 含 LMFP。
New EV registration capacity; LFP includes LMFP.

label: 锂离子名义制造能力
Li-ion nameplate manufacturing capacity
scope: 制造能力与实际产出、装车量分别统计。
Manufacturing capability differs from output and deployment.

label: 美国公用事业级电池功率
US utility-scale battery power
scope: 功率指标；不包括全部分布式储能。
Power, not energy; not all distributed storage.

label: 当年新增电池功率
Battery power added that year
scope: 新增量，不是累计存量或 GWh。
Annual addition, not cumulative stock or GWh.

label: 凝聚态单体比能量
Condensed-cell specific energy
scope: 企业技术发布；商业供应另需核实。
Company technology announcement; availability requires separate evidence.

title: 清洁制氢与电解水
Clean hydrogen & electrolysis
deck: 核对制氢成本、实际电解装机和产量。
Inspect hydrogen costs, commissioned electrolysis and production.
about: 电解水以电能驱动产氢和产氧反应，电极催化剂、膜与电堆决定效率和稳定性。是否低排放还取决于供电和完整生产路径；“清洁氢”“可再生氢”与“电解氢”范围并不完全相同。

Electrolysis uses electricity to drive hydrogen and oxygen evolution. Catalysts, membranes and stacks determine efficiency and durability. Emissions depend on electricity and production pathways; clean, renewable and electrolytic hydrogen are not identical categories.
questions: 成本是平准化制造成本还是销售价格？
Is the metric levelized production cost or selling price?
装机是已投运电输入功率还是设备年制造能力？
Is capacity commissioned electrical input or annual manufacturing?
产氢量是否包含化石路线与碳捕集？
Does output include fossil routes with capture?

title: 电极催化与系统能耗
Catalysis and system energy
body: 降低析氢、析氧过电位有助于减少电堆损失，但项目还包含水处理、压缩、冷却与电力采购。单个催化剂的低过电位不能直接给出每公斤商品氢的完整成本。

Lower electrode overpotentials reduce stack losses, but projects include water treatment, compression, cooling and electricity. One catalyst’s overpotential does not establish the cost of delivered hydrogen.

title: 项目清单与实际产量
Project pipelines and actual output
body: 已宣布、最终投资决定、在建与投运是不同状态。相同电解装机在不同利用小时和效率下产生不同氢量；不以 GW 乘全年小时数补造实际年产量。

Announcement, investment decision, construction and commissioning are different states. Identical capacity can yield different output with utilization and efficiency; nameplate capacity is not converted into invented annual production.

title: 目标与市场期限
Targets and contract deadlines
body: DOE 资料中的 2031 年成本目标，与原题的 2030 年价格判定分别保留。政策目标、工程模型和观察到的价格各有用途，不能在结算时互相替代。
DOE’s 2031 cost target and the contract’s 2030 price deadline remain distinct. Policy goals, engineering models and observed prices serve different purposes.

label: 全球已安装电解容量
Global installed electrolysis
scope: IEA 装机口径；不是制造商 GW/年产能。
IEA installed capacity, not manufacturing GW/year.

label: 低排放氢年产量
Annual low-emissions hydrogen
scope: 包含化石配套 CCUS 等路线，不全为绿氢。
Includes fossil routes with CCUS, not solely green hydrogen.

label: 在建电解容量
Electrolysis under construction
scope: 在建不等于已投运；目标开工时间不作完成时间。
Under construction is not commissioned.

label: Hydrogen Shot 成本目标
Hydrogen Shot cost target
scope: 清洁氢研发目标，未写成已经实现的价格。
Clean-hydrogen development target, not an achieved price.

title: AI 药物研发与临床验证
AI drug discovery & clinical validation
deck: 从分子设计、早期临床到上市批准，逐项查证。
Follow molecular design, early trials and regulatory approval.
about: AI 可以参与靶点发现、分子生成或蛋白设计，但一项结构预测与具备可开发性的药物之间还需要合成、活性、选择性和安全性验证。专题分别收录临床启动、I 期完成及 FDA 批准预测。

AI can support target discovery, molecular generation and protein design. Developable drugs additionally need synthesis, activity, selectivity and safety evidence. Contracts separately address clinical entry, phase-I completion and FDA approval.
questions: AI 具体参与了靶点、结构还是分子设计？
Did AI contribute to targets, structures or molecular design?
主要终点、样本量、对照与随访是什么？
What are the primary endpoint, sample, control and follow-up?
原题要求试验进展还是实际上市批准？
Does the contract require trial progress or marketing approval?

title: 生成分子之后
After molecular generation
body: 分子还需能够合成，并在实验中表现出活性、选择性及可接受的药代与毒理性质。模型评分、体外结合、动物结果和人体试验回答不同问题，不能互相替代。

A proposed molecule needs synthesis, activity, selectivity and acceptable pharmacokinetic/toxicology results. Model scores, in-vitro binding, animal studies and human trials answer different questions.

title: 如何阅读小样本试验
Reading a small trial
body: 先看预设主要终点，再看次要或探索性终点。Rentosertib IIa 期的 71 名受试者、12 周观察和利益关系披露与结果一同展示，不把短期指标变化直接写成长期疗效结论。

Read the prespecified primary endpoint before secondary or exploratory findings. The 71 participants, 12-week period and interests in the rentosertib trial accompany its results, without inferring long-term benefit.

title: 名称与监管里程碑
Names and regulatory milestones
body: 原市场写作 INS018_055，所引论文写作 ISM001-055／rentosertib；检索时保留拼写差别与来源。进入临床、完成 I 期和 FDA 批准各按原题核对，平台 Yes 不作为监管结论。

The market spells INS018_055 while the paper uses ISM001-055/rentosertib; source spellings are retained. Clinical entry, phase-I completion and FDA approval remain distinct, and a platform Yes is not a regulatory finding.

label: IIa 期随机入组
Phase 2a randomized participants
scope: 三种给药组各 18 人，安慰剂 17 人。
Three active groups of 18 and placebo group of 17.

label: 试验给药观察期
Trial treatment period
scope: 有限随访；不能推出长期结局。
Limited follow-up; not long-term outcomes.

label: 至少一次治疗期间不良事件
At least one treatment-emergent adverse event
scope: 依次为三种给药组与安慰剂；小样本结果。
Three active arms followed by placebo; small sample.

label: 肺活量 FVC 变化（次要终点）
FVC change (secondary endpoint)
scope: 60 mg once daily / placebo; 95% CIs 10.9–185.9 and −116.1–75.6 mL.

title: 不对称有机催化
Asymmetric organocatalysis
deck: 从烯胺与亚胺离子活化，读到收率、er、ee 与非对映比。
From enamine/iminium activation to yield, er, ee and diastereomeric ratios.
about: 有机小分子可通过与底物暂时成键或非共价作用控制反应。这里以直接 aldol 和 Diels–Alder 为代表，逐项说明活化方式、底物范围与立体选择性。
Small organic molecules can control reactions through temporary covalent bonding or noncovalent interactions. Direct aldol and Diels–Alder examples connect activation, scope and stereoselectivity.
questions: 催化剂活化的是亲核体还是亲电体？
Does the catalyst activate a nucleophile or electrophile?
收率、ee、er 和 exo:endo 各描述什么？
What do yield, ee, er and exo:endo describe?
范围数据和放大实验能否对应到同一条件？
Do scope and scale-up records share conditions?

title: 脯氨酸催化的直接 aldol
Direct proline-catalyzed aldol
transformation: 丙酮 + 醛 → 手性 β-羟基酮
catalyst: L-脯氨酸；经烯胺形成提高亲核性。
conditions: 官方范围图：30 mol%、DMSO，6 个底物示例；逐个底物条件以原文为准。
Official scope figure: 30 mol%, DMSO, six examples; substrate-specific conditions follow the original paper.
limits: 范围端点不一定来自同一底物；er 不写成 ee。
Range endpoints may come from different substrates; er is not reported as ee.
locator: 诺奖科学背景印刷第 4 页式 2；原始论文及 SI。
Nobel background printed p. 4, equation 2; original paper/SI.

title: 亚胺离子活化的 Diels–Alder
Iminium-activated Diels–Alder
transformation: 肉桂醛 + 环戊二烯 → 手性环加成产物
catalyst: 论文催化剂 7，5 mol%；可逆形成亚胺离子。
Paper catalyst 7, 5 mol%; reversible iminium formation.
conditions: 表 1 条目 5：8 h；另有 50 mmol 制备规模实验。
Table 1 entry 5: 8 h; a separate 50 mmol preparation is reported.
outcome: 99% 收率；exo:endo 1.3:1；exo 为 93% ee。放大段落得 12 g。
99% yield; 1.3:1 exo:endo; exo 93% ee. Preparative paragraph reports 12 g.
limits: 总收率、非对映比和 exo ee 分别记录；实验室放大不等于工业生产。
Yield, diastereomeric ratio and exo ee remain separate; laboratory scale is not industrial output.
locator: JACS 表 1 条目 5；正文制备应用段落。

label: 脯氨酸用量
Proline loading
scope: 式 2 的 6 个范围示例；DMSO。
Equation 2, six scope examples; DMSO.

label: 官方范围图示例数
Examples in official scope figure
scope: 只统计式 2 所示范围，非完整文献总数。
Equation 2 only, not all literature examples.

label: aldol 收率范围
Aldol yield range
scope: 范围图不同底物，不能与最佳 er 拼成单一纪录。
Different substrates; not a combined optimum with best er.

label: aldol 对映体比例
Aldol enantiomeric ratio
scope: er，非 ee；与具体底物匹配。
er, not ee; match individual substrate.

label: Diels–Alder 催化剂 7 用量
Diels–Alder catalyst-7 loading
scope: 肉桂醛／环戊二烯；该条目 8 h。
Cinnamaldehyde/cyclopentadiene; 8 h.

label: Diels–Alder 总收率
Diels–Alder total yield
scope: exo:endo 为 1.3:1，不是单一非对映体收率。
exo:endo 1.3:1; not single-diastereomer yield.

label: exo 产物对映体过量
Exo product enantiomeric excess
scope: 仅 exo 组分；不与 endo 混为总体 ee。
Exo fraction only; not a pooled endo/exo ee.

label: 实验室制备投料规模
Laboratory preparative scale
scope: 与表 1 筛选条目分开记录。
Separate preparative run from screening entry.

label: 制备实验产物质量
Preparative product mass
scope: 原文同时报告 99% 收率与 exo 93% ee，非工厂产量。
Also reports 99% yield/exo 93% ee; not factory output.

title: 烯胺与亚胺离子
Enamines and iminium ions
body: 烯胺形成可提高羰基 α 位的亲核性；不饱和亚胺离子形成可增强亲电反应性。这是活化模式说明，具体中间体和过渡态证据仍以原文研究为准。
Enamine formation increases α-carbon nucleophilicity, while unsaturated iminium formation enhances electrophilic reactivity. Specific intermediate/transition-state evidence remains source-dependent.

title: 立体选择性要分层阅读
Separate stereochemical metrics
body: ee = |R−S|/(R+S)×100%，er 是两对映体的比例；非对映体比例另用 dr 或 exo:endo。Diels–Alder 例的 exo 93% ee 与 1.3:1 非对映比可以同时成立。
ee is |R−S|/(R+S)×100%, er is an enantiomer ratio, and diastereomers need dr or exo:endo. Exo 93% ee and a 1.3:1 diastereomeric ratio can coexist.

title: 从反应方法到过程评价
From method to process assessment
body: 催化剂摩尔分数、溶剂、分离步骤和底物范围都会影响实用性。无金属有机催化不自动代表更低的过程能耗、溶剂消耗或废物量。
Loading, solvent, workup and scope affect practical use. Metal-free organocatalysis alone does not establish lower energy, solvent use or waste.

title: 可见光光氧化还原合成
Visible-light photoredox synthesis
deck: 自由基生成、手性控制与光反应条件分别核对。
Inspect radical generation, stereocontrol and illumination conditions separately.
about: 光激发可改变催化剂的单电子转移能力，有机催化则可提供底物活化与手性环境。本专题比较 Ru／胺双催化与有机染料路线，保留各自条件。
Photoexcitation changes single-electron-transfer capability while organocatalysts activate substrates and provide stereocontrol. Ru/amine and organic-dye routes retain their distinct conditions.
questions: 光催化剂和有机催化剂分别承担什么作用？
What roles do the photo- and organocatalysts play?
光源功率、波长、几何和反应温度是否同时记录？
Are power, spectrum, geometry and temperature documented?
收率与 ee 是否来自同一底物和条件？
Do yield and ee refer to the same substrate and conditions?

title: 双催化醛 α-烷基化
Dual-catalytic aldehyde α-alkylation
transformation: 辛醛 + 溴代丙二酸二乙酯 → α-取代醛
catalyst: Ru(bpy)₃Cl₂ 0.5 mol% + 手性有机催化剂 6 20 mol%。
conditions: DMF、2,6-lutidine、23 °C、15 W 荧光灯；表 1 通用图示。
DMF, 2,6-lutidine, 23 °C, 15 W fluorescent lamp; Table 1 conditions.
outcome: 同一条目 1：93% 收率、90% ee。
limits: 灯泡瓦数不等于有效照射强度；其他底物条目的例外催化剂用量不被覆盖。
Lamp wattage is not irradiance; exceptions in other substrate entries are not overwritten.
locator: Science 表 1 条目 1、催化剂组合图及脚注。
Science Table 1 entry 1, catalyst box and footnotes.

title: 染料介导的无过渡金属 α-烷基化
Dye-mediated transition-metal-free α-alkylation
transformation: 醛 + 烷基化试剂 → 对映富集 α-烷基化产物
Aldehyde + alkylating reagent → enantioenriched α-alkylated product
catalyst: Rose Bengal + 咪唑烷酮有机催化剂；另有亲电助催化剂。
Rose Bengal + imidazolidinone, with an electrophilic cocatalyst.
conditions: 可见光体系；完整溶剂、剂量和底物条件见原文及 SI。
Visible-light system; exact solvent, dose and substrate conditions follow the paper/SI.
outcome: 原文报告直接对映选择性 α-烷基化；本页不填入未逐项核对的产率。
The source reports direct enantioselective α-alkylation; unverified individual yields are not inserted.
limits: 不把 Ru 体系数据移植至染料体系；无过渡金属不是全流程环境评价。
Ru-system data are not transferred; transition-metal-free is not a lifecycle assessment.
locator: Green Chemistry 正文与补充材料。

label: Ru 光催化剂用量
Ru photocatalyst loading
scope: 与 20 mol% 有机催化剂协同；不是无金属体系。
Combined with 20 mol% organocatalyst; not metal-free.

label: 有机催化剂用量
Organocatalyst loading
scope: 条目 1；其他条目如有脚注例外需另查。
Entry 1; exceptions require footnote review.

label: 荧光灯额定功率
Fluorescent-lamp rated power
scope: 灯泡功率，非光通量、光子通量或量子产率。
Lamp rating, not flux or quantum yield.

label: 反应温度
Reaction temperature
scope: DMF、荧光灯体系；不推广到所有光反应。
DMF/fluorescent-lamp system, not all photoreactions.

label: 辛醛 α-烷基化收率
Octanal α-alkylation yield
scope: 溴代丙二酸二乙酯体系；与相邻行 ee 同一条目。
Diethyl bromomalonate system; same entry as the adjacent ee.

label: 辛醛 α-烷基化 ee
Octanal α-alkylation ee
scope: 对应 93% 收率条目；不是全部底物平均值。
Same entry as 93% yield; not a scope average.

title: 单电子转移与两电子反应
Single-electron and two-electron chemistry
body: 自由基生成提供不同的成键路径，但反应是否成功仍取决于电子转移、催化循环和底物匹配。机理图表示研究提出的过程，不能仅凭高产率证明每个中间体。
Radical generation enables different bond-forming paths, but electron transfer, turnover and substrate matching still matter. A proposed mechanism is not established solely by high yield.

title: 光反应的可比条件
Comparable photochemical conditions
body: 波长分布、灯到样品距离、容器、搅拌、溶液吸收和温度都影响结果。只报告 15 W 灯泡不能完整重现有效光剂量，也不能计算量子产率。
Spectrum, distance, vessel, mixing, absorption and temperature influence results. A 15 W rating does not reproduce absorbed light dose or determine quantum yield.

title: 绿色主张要核算全流程
Assess the whole process
body: 可见光或无过渡金属是技术属性。环境比较还需溶剂、助试剂、分离、能源和产物量的共同口径。
Visible-light and transition-metal-free describe methods; environmental comparisons also need solvent, reagents, isolation, energy and product-scale accounting.

title: 点击与生物正交化学
Click & bioorthogonal chemistry
deck: 从 CuAAC 的区域选择性，到无铜连接与成像读出。
From CuAAC regioselectivity to copper-free ligation and imaging readouts.
about: 点击化学强调可靠的分子连接，生物正交还要求反应在复杂生物环境中尽量避免干扰原有过程。这里分别展示固相、溶液 CuAAC 与应变促进路线。

Click chemistry emphasizes reliable molecular connection, while bioorthogonality adds compatibility with complex biological environments. Solid-phase/solution CuAAC and strain-promoted routes are distinguished.
questions: 连接的是哪些官能团，形成哪种区域异构体？
Which functional groups connect and which regioisomer forms?
催化剂、介质和生物相容性怎样对应？
How do catalyst, medium and biological compatibility relate?
检测信号是否能直接代表化学转化？
Does the detection signal directly measure chemical conversion?

title: 固相 CuAAC 肽连接
Solid-phase CuAAC peptide ligation
transformation: 树脂连接末端炔 + 有机叠氮 → 1,4-取代三唑
Resin-bound terminal alkyne + organic azide → 1,4-substituted triazole
catalyst: Cu(I) 催化；极性固相载体。
Cu(I) catalysis on a polar solid support.
conditions: 官方图 6a：碱、THF、25 °C；具体试剂量见原研究。
Official Figure 6a: base, THF, 25 °C; amounts follow the original study.
outcome: 构建肽骨架或侧链三唑，研究多类叠氮底物。
Constructs peptide backbone/side-chain triazoles across azide classes.
limits: 不把树脂负载、区域选择性和分离收率混为一项数值。
Resin loading, regioselectivity and isolated yield remain separate.
locator: JOC 原研究；诺奖科学背景图 6a。
JOC original study; Nobel background Figure 6a.

title: 溶液中原位生成 Cu(I) 的连接
Solution ligation with in-situ Cu(I)
transformation: 有机叠氮 + 末端炔 → 1,4-二取代 1,2,3-三唑
catalyst: CuSO₄·5H₂O／抗坏血酸钠，原位形成 Cu(I)。
outcome: 选择性形成所示 1,4-取代产物；本页不将“高收率”改写成统一百分比。
Selective 1,4-product formation; qualitative high yield is not assigned an invented percentage.
limits: 水相有机合成与活细胞相容性不是同一要求。
Aqueous synthesis and live-cell compatibility impose different requirements.
locator: 诺奖科学背景印刷第 7 页图 6b。

title: 环张力促进的生物正交连接
Strain-promoted bioorthogonal ligation
transformation: 环辛炔类探针 + 叠氮标记生物分子 → 共价连接产物
Cyclooctyne probe + azide-labelled biomolecule → covalent conjugate
catalyst: 环张力驱动；无需铜催化剂。
Ring strain drives reaction; no copper catalyst.
conditions: 2004 生理条件化学；2007 活体系成像是后续独立工作。
Physiological-condition chemistry in 2004; live-system imaging in 2007 is separate follow-up.
outcome: 展示选择性连接与成像应用，不把荧光读出当作分离收率。
Selective ligation and imaging are shown without treating fluorescence as isolated yield.
limits: 反应速率、背景和探针相容性依赖具体结构与环境。
Rate, background and compatibility depend on probe and environment.

label: 早期固相 CuAAC 收率范围
Early solid-phase CuAAC yield range
period: 2001 会议工作；2022 官方汇总
scope: 官方印刷第 6 页；不冒充 2002 全底物统一结果。
Printed p. 6; not a universal 2002 scope result.

label: 固相 CuAAC 图示温度
Solid-phase CuAAC illustrated temperature
scope: Cu(I)、碱、THF；其余参数以原研究为准。
Cu(I), base, THF; remaining details in original study.

label: 溶液 CuAAC 图示温度
Solution CuAAC illustrated temperature
scope: CuSO₄／抗坏血酸钠；水／叔丁醇。
CuSO₄/ascorbate; water/tert-butanol.

title: 区域选择性与原子连接
Regioselectivity and connectivity
body: 末端炔与有机叠氮可形成三唑。CuAAC 选择性形成 1,4-取代产物；非催化热反应与不同金属体系可能有不同的区域选择性。
Terminal alkynes and azides form triazoles. CuAAC favors the 1,4-product, whereas uncatalyzed thermal or other metal systems can differ.

title: 生物正交是额外要求
Bioorthogonality adds requirements
body: 在有机溶剂中高收率连接，并不自动满足细胞中的速率、选择性和相容性。无铜路线仍须检查探针结构、非特异背景与实际反应环境。
High-yield organic-solvent ligation does not automatically meet cellular rate, selectivity or compatibility requirements. Copper-free probes still need background and context checks.

title: 从标记到读数
From labelling to readout
body: 标记反应与显影过程涉及浓度、孵育、清洗、定位及仪器设置。荧光强度的变化需要适当对照，不能未经校准就称为分离产率。
Labelling/readout depends on concentration, incubation, washing, localization and instruments. Fluorescence changes need controls and are not uncalibrated isolated yields.

title: PET 解聚与酶催化循环
PET depolymerization & enzymatic recycling
deck: 把酯键水解、单体回收、再聚合和工厂处理能力分别计量。

title: VTT：受委托测试的范围
VTT: scope of commissioned measurements
body:
VTT 说明其接受委托，在实验室测量 Donut Lab 所提供电池的性能。核对时应回到具体报告：测了什么、由谁提供样品、哪些结论没有涵盖；测试机构名称不等于对企业全部产品主张的认证。

查阅测量时应先核对委托范围、样品数量、温度、充放电程序和报告签发时间。受委托开展的测试可以提供独立测量，但测试机构的参与并不自动覆盖公司对材料体系、寿命或量产能力的全部表述。

VTT describes commissioned laboratory measurements on customer-supplied batteries. Read each report for its measurements, sample provenance and scope; the institution’s name does not certify every product claim.

Review the commissioned scope, sample count, temperature, cycling protocol and report date. Independent measurements on submitted samples do not cover every company claim about chemistry, lifetime or production.

title: LK-99 的合成、表征与输运测量
LK-99 synthesis, characterization and transport measurements
body: 曼彻斯特大学相关研究的原始论文报告了合成、表征与输运测量，并未在其 LK-99 样品中观察到超导信号。结论适用于论文中的样品和方法；它与“是否出现独立实验论文”的市场可以同时成立。

The original study reports synthesis, characterization and transport measurements without observing superconductivity in its LK-99 samples. Its sample-specific finding can coexist with a Yes outcome on whether an independent experimental paper appeared.
citation: arXiv:2308.03823v2 (2023). DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.2308.03823. Full authors and affiliations are in the paper.

title: CALF-20：从吸附材料到供应合作
CALF-20: from sorbent to a supply agreement
body:

这项合作对应吸附剂供应链：BASF 负责材料生产，Svante 将其用于结构化过滤器。读者还需区分吸附剂吨数、过滤器数量与下游 CO₂ 捕集量；它们不能按同一口径相加。

Svante reports a BASF commercial supply agreement for CALF-20 MOF sorbent used in structured filters. Material supply and manufacturing are distinct from planned facilities, future capacity and measured operating capture.

The collaboration concerns a sorbent supply chain: BASF manufactures materials and Svante integrates structured filters. Sorbent mass, filter output and downstream CO₂ capture are different quantities.

title: BASF：MOF 生产与碳捕集用途
BASF: MOF production for carbon capture
body:
BASF 的资料说明其 MOF 放大与生产工作及 Svante 合作关系。材料制造能力有助于讨论工程放大；若要比较过程成本、寿命或减排量，还需要对应装置和工况的独立数据。

从粉体到装置还需要成型、传热传质和循环再生。判断工程价值，应继续查找湿度、杂质、再生能耗和长期循环下的材料损耗，而不只比较一次吸附容量。

BASF describes MOF scale-up and its Svante relationship. Manufacturing capability informs scale-up assessment; process cost, lifetime and avoided emissions require plant-specific operating data.

Powder-to-plant deployment also requires forming, transport and cyclic regeneration. Humidity, impurities, regeneration energy and long-term material loss matter alongside single-cycle capacity.

title: Intertek：送检软包电池组分的锂、钠定量

title: ETH Zürich／Empa：LLZO 与锂金属的界面问题
ETH Zürich / Empa: the LLZO–lithium interface
body: 论文讨论表面清洁和界面层如何影响润湿、界面阻抗与锂沉积／剥离。改善一个实验电池的界面，并不等于已经解决大面积薄片制造、装配和良率；文献也指出部分作用机理仍缺乏共识。它解释 LLZO 商业化题目的技术障碍，不提供某家工厂已达 1 GWh 的证据。

The Comment examines cleaning and interlayers in wettability, interface resistance and lithium plating/stripping, noting unresolved mechanisms. A laboratory interface improvement does not establish large-area manufacturing yield or a facility’s 1 GWh output.

QuantumScape: installation of key Eagle Line equipment
kind: 企业原始公告 · 中试制造
body:
公司公告称已安装用于提高 QSE-5 电芯产量的关键设备，Eagle Line 结合 Cobra 隔膜工艺和自动化电芯生产。公告把它定位为中试线，以及未来许可伙伴放大的基础。它不是“PowerCo Unified Cell 格式样品已得到双方确认”的同义说法，也不代表已达到吉瓦时商业产量。

设备安装完成属于产线建设节点。判断样品能否进入客户验证，还需看设备联调、稳定产出、电芯规格、批次一致性和客户接收记录；产线启用时间也不能直接当作量产汽车交付日期。

QS reports installing equipment for higher-volume QSE-5 production, combining Cobra separators and automation in a pilot line. It describes a basis for future licensee scale-up, not proof of a jointly confirmed PowerCo Unified Cell sample or gigawatt-hour commercial output.

Equipment installation is a line-building milestone. Commissioning, stable output, cell specifications, batch consistency and customer receipt are subsequent checks; line inauguration is not a vehicle-delivery date.

title: Toyota／出光：从硫化物电解质到整车的三阶段路线
Toyota / Idemitsu: a three-stage sulfide-to-vehicle pathway
kind: 联合企业公告 · 研发与量产计划
body:
双方合作以硫化物固体电解质为重点：先完善材料和大型中试准备，再推进中试制造及车型开发，最后研究全面量产。材料软、易黏附有利于加工，但循环中的界面开裂与耐久性仍是工程问题。公告中的 2027–2028 目标是计划，不是客户已收车的记录。

合作内容涉及电解质开发、小型试验设施到更大规模示范的衔接，以及后续供应链建设。公告中的 2027–2028 年商业化目标是当时的计划；判断整车事件仍须核对车型、固态体系、测试工况与客户实际收车。

The partnership focuses on sulfide electrolytes, progressing from material/pilot preparation to pilot manufacturing and vehicle development, then full-scale production studies. Interfacial durability remains an engineering issue. Its 2027–2028 target is a plan rather than a retail delivery record.

The partnership connects electrolyte development, pilot work, scale-up demonstration and supply-chain preparation. The announced 2027–2028 commercialization window is a target, while vehicle contracts need model-specific tests and actual customer delivery.

title: Toyota：区分液态电解质电池与固态路线的性能目标
Toyota: separate liquid-electrolyte and solid-state targets
body: 路线图同时讨论液态与固态方案。“约 1000 km”等整车目标还受车辆效率影响，快充目标则注明荷电状态区间。比较原市场的 1000 km 与少于 15 分钟条件，需要确认同一车型、同一电池路线和充电区间，不能把不同方案的最佳数字拼到一起。

The roadmap covers liquid and solid electrolytes. Range also depends on vehicle efficiency; charge-time targets specify a state-of-charge interval. The contract’s range and charging conditions must apply to the same vehicle and chemistry, not a mixture of targets from different programs.

title: Apple：当前电池原理说明与快充阶段
Apple: battery explanation and charging stages
body: Apple 的说明使用锂离子电池框架，并解释快充至约 80% 后转为较慢充电。快充、循环优化或更高能量密度本身都不能证明手机换用了固态电解质。判断这一市场要查具体发布产品的电池技术资料；这份说明不是对所有未来型号的承诺。

Apple explains lithium-ion charging, including a fast phase followed by slower charging around 80%. Faster charging and better endurance alone do not establish solid electrolytes. The market requires product-specific battery evidence; this general page does not promise every future model’s chemistry.

title: DOE：零电阻、排磁与临界条件
DOE: zero resistance, field expulsion and critical conditions
body: 超导体在临界温度以下可无直流电阻地传输电流，并呈现排磁行为；超过临界电流会破坏超导态。已经应用于 MRI 等装置的超导体并不因此满足“常压、0 °C 以上、无需主动冷却”的合同条件。材料发现与可销售器件是两道门槛。

Superconductors have zero DC resistance and field-expulsion behavior below critical conditions; excessive current destroys the state. Existing MRI applications do not satisfy a contract requiring ambient pressure, above 0 °C and no active cooling. Material discovery and a saleable device are separate milestones.

title: 中国科学院物理研究所：Cu₂S 杂相与电阻突变
Institute of Physics, CAS: Cu₂S impurities and resistance transitions
kind: 原始实验研究 · Matter / arXiv
body: 研究比较 Cu₂S 与含 Cu₂S 的 LK-99 样品，观测到类似超导转变的电阻变化和热滞后，却未观察到零电阻。论文提出，约 385 K 的硫化亚铜结构转变可以解释该类异常。这说明电阻曲线出现骤降，需要连同物相、磁性和测量下限一起判断。

The study finds resistance transitions and thermal hysteresis in Cu₂S and Cu₂S-containing LK-99, without zero resistivity. It attributes the anomaly to a structural transition around 385 K. A sharp resistance drop therefore needs phase, magnetic and measurement-limit checks.

title: Sandia 等机构：碳酸酐酶辅助的 CO₂ 分离膜
Sandia and collaborators: carbonic-anhydrase separation membranes
body:
研究将碳酸酐酶置于亲水纳米孔结构中，在论文条件下提高 CO₂ 分离通量和选择性。这证明酶可以参与分离材料设计；它不证明该方法使用了 AlphaFold，也不等同于已完成低浓度空气的工业碳移除。完整作者与合作机构见原论文。

膜性能需要结合进料组成、温度、湿度与稳定运行时间阅读。酶参与传质的实验结果可以支持材料路线研究；要评价捕集工艺，还应继续核对膜面积、再生或更换频率和系统能耗。

Carbonic anhydrase confined in hydrophilic nanopores supports CO₂ separation under the paper’s conditions. This establishes an enzyme-based material approach, not AlphaFold involvement or deployed industrial direct-air removal. The paper lists all authors and collaborating institutions.

Read membrane performance with feed composition, temperature, humidity and operating duration. Enzyme-assisted transport informs materials research; process evaluation additionally needs area, replacement or regeneration frequency and system energy.
citation: Nature Communications 9, 990 (2018). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-018-03285-x。完整合作机构见原文。
Nature Communications 9, 990 (2018). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-018-03285-x. Full collaborating affiliations are in the paper.

title: Google DeepMind：AlphaFold 输出的是什么
Google DeepMind: what AlphaFold predicts
body: AlphaFold 用于预测生物分子结构及相互作用。结构预测可以为酶的实验设计提供起点，但催化速率、溶剂稳定性和捕集过程的能耗仍需实验或过程数据。仅在论文中使用一次模型，与原市场所说的“参与领先空气捕集方法”，不是相同证据门槛。

AlphaFold predicts biomolecular structures and interactions. That can guide enzyme experiments, but catalytic rates, solvent stability and process energy still require measurements or process data. A single model use is not the same as the contract’s leading-DAC criterion.

title: NOAA：海洋增碱与碳移除的测量边界
NOAA: measurement boundaries in ocean alkalinity enhancement
body: 海洋增碱改变海水化学，使其有能力吸收更多空气 CO₂；碱度变化与已经发生的净大气移除需要分别测量。NOAA 将可扩展性、成本、生态影响等列为研究问题。因此，橄榄石溶解、矿物投放量和每年净移除十亿吨并不是同一个量。

Ocean alkalinity enhancement increases seawater’s capacity to absorb atmospheric CO₂. Alkalinity change and realized net atmospheric removal require separate measurement. NOAA identifies scale, cost and ecological effects as research questions; mineral dissolution or deployment tonnage is not annual net carbon removal.

title: NOAA Fisheries：橄榄石的短期生态实验
NOAA Fisheries: short-term olivine ecology experiments
body: 短期实验观察到海水碱度和 pH 增加，未见浮游植物过量积累重金属；同时发现矿物带来的氮需要控制。报道明确保留长期生态效应的不确定性。这里的样品和实验范围不能外推成全球部署规模或长期安全结论。

The short-term experiment observed higher alkalinity and pH without excess heavy-metal accumulation in phytoplankton, while identifying nitrogen addition as a concern. Long-term effects remain unresolved. These experimental conditions do not establish global deployment or long-term safety.

title: Svante：Redwood 过滤器工厂的产能口径
Svante: what Redwood filter capacity measures
kind: 企业原始公告 · 制造设施
body:
Svante 宣布 Redwood 过滤器制造设施完成调试，称其年产过滤器可支持最高约 1000 万吨 CO₂ 的年捕集能力。这是按过滤器用途表述的制造能力，不是工厂自身每年已经从空气移除了 1000 万吨。要核实减排或碳移除，需要下游装置的运行量、能源与永久封存记录。

制造设施的利用率与下游装置的开工时间会影响最终捕集规模。公告中的能力指标适合追踪供应准备情况；核算净减排还应计入吸附剂生产、再生热源、压缩运输及封存环节。

Svante reports commissioning Redwood and describes annual filter output sufficient to support up to 10 million tonnes of annual CO₂ capture capacity. That is filter-manufacturing capacity, not CO₂ already removed by the factory. Downstream operation, energy and permanent-storage records are needed for removal claims.

Factory utilization and downstream commissioning affect realized capture. Manufacturing capacity tracks supply readiness; net abatement additionally depends on material production, regeneration heat, compression, transport and storage.

title: SuperPower：已商业供应的 REBCO 超导线材
SuperPower: commercially supplied REBCO conductors
body:
公司供应第二代高温超导线材，官网说明的运行例子仍在 77 K、30 K、4.2 K 等低温条件下。“高温超导”是相对传统超导体的术语，并不表示高于 0 °C。该产品说明既有制造和应用链条，但不是 LK-99 被采用或原题常温商品条件已经实现的证据。

线材应用还取决于磁场、温度、电流方向及机械载荷。工程比较需要查看对应条件下的临界电流和线材长度，区分短样测试、可供货线材和装入设备后的系统表现。

The supplier describes second-generation HTS conductors operating at cryogenic temperatures such as 77 K, 30 K and 4.2 K. High-temperature does not mean above 0 °C. Its product establishes an existing manufacturing chain, not LK-99 adoption or satisfaction of these ambient-temperature contracts.

Conductor performance also depends on field, temperature, current orientation and strain. Compare critical current and length under specified conditions, distinguishing short samples, delivered tape and complete devices.

title: Saipem：CO₂ Solutions 的工业酶法捕集路线
Saipem: industrial enzymatic capture with CO₂ Solutions
body:
Saipem 介绍以碳酸盐溶剂和酶为基础的工业排放捕集技术，并讨论余热利用与过程集成。这是判断“酶法有没有工程应用”的一份企业资料。页面没有据此证明 AlphaFold 的参与，也没有将其定义为从空气中移除 CO₂ 的领先方法，不能替原题补齐这两个条件。

这类流程利用酶加快 CO₂ 与溶剂之间的转化，吸收与再生仍需要完整的工艺系统。对照其他技术时，应在相近进气浓度、捕集率和热源条件下比较，而非把工业烟气结果直接用于低浓度空气。

Saipem describes enzyme/carbonate-solvent capture of industrial emissions and process integration. It supplies industrial context for enzymes, without establishing AlphaFold involvement or leadership in direct air capture. Those extra contract conditions remain separate.

Enzymes accelerate CO₂/solvent conversion within an absorption/regeneration system. Comparisons require similar inlet concentration, capture fraction and heat supply; industrial-flue results do not directly describe ambient-air capture.

title: Vesta：橄榄石沿岸试验与监测
Vesta: coastal olivine pilots and monitoring
body:
Vesta 的科学资料介绍沿岸增强风化试验，目标包括测量天然条件下的橄榄石溶解速率、碳移除效率与生态影响。公开试验说明路线在实地研究，并不等于已实现原题要求的每年十亿吨。公司提出的长期愿景与实际项目监测结果须分开读。

实地监测需要将背景海水变化与投放后的变化分开，并追踪矿物溶解与海气 CO₂ 交换的时间差。年度净移除还需要完整的物料与排放核算，不能仅由投放量推算。

Vesta describes coastal trials studying olivine dissolution, carbon-removal efficiency and ecology. A field pilot shows research under natural conditions, not achievement of the contract’s annual gigatonne threshold. Ambition and measured project results remain separate.

Field monitoring must separate background variability and deployment effects, including delays between dissolution and air–sea exchange. Annual net removal needs mass and emissions accounting beyond mineral deployment.

title: DOE：NIF 点火实验与能量计量边界
DOE: NIF ignition and the energy boundary
body: 美国能源部于 2022 年 12 月 13 日公布：NIF 在 12 月 5 日的实验中，以 2.05 MJ 激光能量驱动靶丸，产生 3.15 MJ 聚变能量。这个结果比较的是到靶激光与聚变产能，不是设施从电网取电与送回电网的电量。它是惯性约束聚变实验进展，不能直接作为 Helion 不同技术路线已实现净发电的证明。

DOE announced on 13 December 2022 that the 5 December NIF shot delivered 2.05 MJ of laser energy and produced 3.15 MJ of fusion energy. The comparison excludes whole-facility electricity consumption. This inertial-confinement result does not verify net electricity from Helion’s different approach.

title: Helion：与 Microsoft 签订聚变购电协议
Helion: fusion power purchase agreement with Microsoft
kind: 企业原始公告 · 购电协议
body: Helion 在 2023 年 5 月 10 日宣布与 Microsoft 签订供电协议，由 Constellation 负责电力营销与输送管理。公告计划在 2028 年上线，并在一年的爬坡期后达到至少 50 MW。协议说明了客户与目标规模，未提供已实现净发电或已向客户交付的计量结果。原市场要求在 2029 年前交付 50 MW，核对时尤其要注意爬坡时间与交付期限的差别。

On 10 May 2023 Helion announced a Microsoft agreement with Constellation managing power marketing and transmission. It targeted operation in 2028 and at least 50 MW after a one-year ramp. The agreement establishes a customer and target, not measured net generation or completed delivery; the market’s pre-2029 deadline needs separate review.

title: Google Quantum AI：Willow 的阈值以下量子纠错
Google Quantum AI: below-threshold correction on Willow
body: 2024 年 12 月 9 日公开的研究报告了 Willow 处理器上的阈值以下表面码存储器，包括距离 7 与距离 5 的编码。增加编码规模时逻辑错误率降低，是纠错可扩展性的一项实验依据。论文针对存储器的结果不等于已完成一亿门的通用容错计算，也不单独证明产品已对外商业供应。

Published on 9 December 2024, the work reports below-threshold surface-code memories on Willow, including distance-7 and distance-5 codes. Lower logical error with larger codes supports scalable correction. A memory experiment does not establish general 100-million-gate computation or commercial availability.

title: Google Research：纠错规模与逻辑错误率
Google Research: code size and logical errors
body: Google 的技术说明解释了为什么必须先低于物理错误阈值，扩大纠错编码才可能降低逻辑错误。它将处理器、重复测量与解码过程放在同一个实验中讨论，便于理解逻辑存储结果。评估长程序还需核对逻辑门、测量与控制的完整过程，不能只用芯片物理比特数判断可运行算法的规模。

Google explains why physical errors must be below a threshold before increasing code size suppresses logical errors. Its memory demonstration combines the processor, repeated measurements and decoding. Long algorithms additionally need verified logical operations and controls; physical qubit counts alone do not establish computational scale.

title: Oxford PV：首批商业叠层组件出货
Oxford PV: first commercial tandem module shipment
kind: 企业原始公告 · 产品交付
body: Oxford PV 于 2024 年 9 月 5 日宣布向美国客户首次商业出货。公告介绍的 72 电池片组件采用钙钛矿／硅叠层结构，首批产品组件效率为 24.5%，电池来自德国勃兰登堡的 MW 级试验线。实际出货比效率纪录更接近商业交付，但这一公告没有给出单一制造商年度 1 GW 的出货证明。后续 GW 级工厂仍是该公告中的扩产计划。

On 5 September 2024 Oxford PV announced its first commercial shipment to a US customer. Its 72-cell perovskite/silicon modules had 24.5% module efficiency, using cells from a MW-scale pilot line in Brandenburg, Germany. A first shipment is commercial evidence, but does not establish annual 1 GW delivery; future GW-scale manufacturing was a plan.

title: DOE：钙钛矿光伏的稳定性与规模制造
DOE: perovskite durability and manufacturing
body: 美国能源部将长期稳定性、放大后的效率、可制造性及技术验证与融资认可列为商业化挑战。叠层结构通过不同吸收层利用不同波段，效率优势需要在完整组件上保持。评价商品还应核对封装、户外衰减、批次一致性与质保；实验室小电池的纪录无法直接回答年度商业出货或全球部署占比。

DOE identifies durability, efficiency at scale, manufacturability and validation/bankability as commercialization challenges. Tandem absorbers use different spectral bands, but gains must survive module integration. Encapsulation, outdoor degradation, batch consistency and warranties matter beyond small-cell efficiency records.

title: CATL／长安：钠离子乘用车发布与性能口径
CATL/CHANGAN: sodium-ion vehicle launch and performance scope
kind: 企业原始公告 · 车型发布
body: 2026 年 2 月 5 日公告介绍 Naxtra 钠离子乘用车，电池比能量最高 175 Wh/kg，车辆纯电续航超过 400 km，并称 −40 °C 容量保持率超过 90%。这些是企业披露的性能，续航还受车型与工况影响。公告写的是发布及计划在 2026 年中上市，不能仅凭该页面判定已经向零售客户交车。

The 5 February 2026 release reports up to 175 Wh/kg, over 400 km vehicle range and over 90% capacity retention at −40 °C. These are company-reported claims; range depends on vehicle and conditions. A launch with a planned mid-2026 market introduction is not a customer delivery record.

title: CATL：Naxtra 安全认证公告
CATL: Naxtra safety certification announcement
kind: 企业原始公告 · 安全测试
body: CATL 在 2025 年 9 月 8 日公告称，Naxtra 于 9 月 5 日通过 GB 38031-2025 对应认证，测试涉及电芯和电池包。这里记录企业对第三方测试的披露；标准测试结果、商业产量和实际交付是不同证据。完整项目与适用范围应继续查阅原认证文件。

On 8 September 2025 CATL reported Naxtra certification on 5 September, covering cell and pack tests under GB 38031-2025. This records the company’s disclosure of testing, not commercial output or delivery; the original certification defines the full scope.

title: CATL：凝聚态电池的单体 500 Wh/kg 公告
CATL: the 500 Wh/kg condensed-cell announcement
kind: 企业原始公告 · 电池技术
body: 2023 年 4 月 19 日发布的凝聚态电池公告提出最高 500 Wh/kg 的单体比能量，涉及电解质、正负极与制造工艺。单体性能不能直接换算为整包表现；技术发布也不等于可购买产品已达到相同指标。此路线不在本站被直接归为“全固态”。

The 19 April 2023 announcement states up to 500 Wh/kg at cell level, involving electrolytes, electrodes and manufacturing. Cell performance is not pack performance, and a launch is not proof of a purchasable product at that value. This archive does not automatically classify it as all-solid-state.

title: DOE：2008–2023 年轻型车电池包成本估计
DOE: estimated light-duty battery pack costs, 2008–2023
body: DOE 以 2023 年不变美元估计，轻型车锂离子电池包成本从 2008 年的 1,415 美元/kWh 降至 2023 年的 139 美元/kWh。分母是可用能量，2023 年假设年产至少 10 万套。它是规模制造模型估计，不能当作某个地区的零售价、单体报价或未来成交价格。

DOE estimates light-duty lithium-ion pack costs of $1,415/kWh in 2008 and $139/kWh in 2023, in constant 2023 dollars and per usable energy. The 2023 case assumes at least 100,000 packs/year. These modeled manufacturing costs are not retail or cell prices.

title: IEA 2026：电池部署、LFP 份额与制造能力
IEA 2026: battery deployment, LFP share and manufacturing
body: 报告整理 2025 年 EV 电池部署为 1.2 TWh、LFP 占部署量超过 55%，并区分超过 4 TWh 的锂离子电池名义制造能力。LFP 分类包含磷酸锰铁锂，份额以新注册电动车的电池容量计算。因此不能直接代替原市场“乘用及轻型商用车生产出货 GWh”的 2026 年分母。

The report records 1.2 TWh of EV battery deployment in 2025, an LFP deployment share over 55%, and over 4 TWh of lithium-ion nameplate manufacturing capacity. LFP includes LMFP and share uses battery capacity in newly registered EVs, differing from the market’s 2026 passenger/light-commercial production-shipment denominator.

title: EIA：2024 年美国公用事业级电池储能
EIA: US utility-scale battery storage in 2024
kind: 政府机构统计 · 指定历史版本
body: 2025 年 3 月 12 日文章依据 2025 年 1 月初步清单，记录 2024 年美国公用事业级电池功率超过 26 GW，当年新增 10.4 GW。GW 是功率，不是 GWh 能量；公用事业级范围也不等于全行业。该历史版本保留原统计时点，不与后续修订拼接为同一序列。

Using the January 2025 preliminary inventory, EIA’s 12 March article records over 26 GW of US utility-scale battery power in 2024 and 10.4 GW added that year. Power is not GWh energy; utility-scale is not all sectors. This dated edition is not spliced with later revisions.

title: 钒液流电池：电解液浓度与荷电状态测量
Vanadium flow batteries: concentration and state-of-charge measurement
kind: 原始研究 · 公开预印本
body: 该研究给出利用紫外—可见光谱测量钒电解液总浓度和荷电状态的方法与开放数据。全钒液流体系的负极侧涉及 V(II)/V(III)，正极侧涉及 V(IV)/V(V)。电解液需求量与装机能量有关，但全球用钒占比仍需要按钒元素质量核对供应、库存与消费统计，不能由电池数量直接推算。

The study provides UV–visible methods and open data for vanadium concentration and state of charge. All-vanadium electrolytes involve V(II)/V(III) and V(IV)/V(V) couples. Electrolyte demand relates to energy capacity, but global use shares need contained-V consumption, supply and inventory accounting.

title: DOE：Hydrogen Shot 的成本目标与年份
DOE: Hydrogen Shot cost target and timing
body: 2023 年 12 月 5 日 DOE 资料将 Hydrogen Shot 表述为到 2031 年把清洁氢成本降至 1 美元/kg，降幅 80%。这是研发与部署目标，且清洁氢并不只包含可再生电解制氢。原市场采用 2030 年、可再生氢价格指数的条件，不能将官方目标年份或路径直接替换进其规则。

DOE’s 5 December 2023 release targets $1/kg clean hydrogen by 2031, an 80% reduction. This is a development target covering more than renewable electrolysis. The market instead uses 2030 and a renewable-hydrogen price index; its rules remain distinct.

title: IEA 2026：实际电解装机与低排放氢产量
IEA 2026: installed electrolysis and low-emissions hydrogen
body: 报告记载 2025 年全球已安装电解容量超过 4 GW，低排放氢产量接近 100 万吨；另有超过 2.5 GW 电解容量在建。已投运、在建、制造商年产能与已宣布项目不是同一指标。低排放氢也包含配套碳捕集的化石路线，不能把该产量全部归为绿氢。

The report records over 4 GW installed electrolysis in 2025 and almost 1 Mt of low-emissions hydrogen, with over 2.5 GW under construction. Installed, under-construction, manufacturing and announced capacity differ. Low-emissions output also includes fossil pathways with capture, not only green hydrogen.

title: FDA：临床阶段与批准流程
FDA: clinical phases and approval
body: FDA 将早期临床的安全性与剂量、后续的有效性及不良反应研究区分。完成 I 期、进入 II 期、获得突破性疗法认定和获得上市批准并不等同。AI 工具的参与需要独立证据；不能根据试验阶段或市场结算推断一种药物已获批准。

FDA distinguishes early safety/dose studies from later efficacy and adverse-event research. Completing phase I, entering phase II, receiving a designation and marketing approval are different milestones. AI involvement also needs evidence; trial stage or market resolution does not imply approval.

title: Rentosertib：AI 发现 TNIK 抑制剂的 IIa 期随机试验
Rentosertib: phase 2a trial of an AI-discovered TNIK inhibitor
body: 论文于 2025 年 6 月 3 日在线发表，随机分配 71 名患者，研究期 12 周，比较三种给药组与安慰剂。主要终点是出现至少一次治疗期间不良事件的患者比例，肺功能是次要终点。研究由 Insilico Medicine 资助，部分作者为公司员工。样本量与随访长度限制了结论范围，论文建议更大规模、长期研究；IIa 期结果不能替代 FDA 批准。

Published online on 3 June 2025, the trial randomized 71 patients over 12 weeks across three active arms and placebo. The primary endpoint was treatment-emergent adverse events, with lung function secondary. Insilico sponsored the study and employed some authors. Larger, longer trials were recommended; this is not FDA approval.
citation: Xu et al., Nature Medicine 31, 2602–2610 (2025). DOI: 10.1038/s41591-025-03743-2; NCT05938920. Full authors and affiliations are in the paper.

title: Climeworks：Mammoth 启动时的名义能力
Climeworks: Mammoth nameplate capacity at startup
kind: 企业原始公告 · 指定历史节点
body: 2024 年 5 月 8 日启动公告给出最高 36,000 吨 CO₂/年的设计捕集能力，当时已安装 72 个计划收集模块中的 12 个。该值是名义能力，不是已交付的净移除量。比较气候作用时，还需运行量、能源排放、封存与核证；后续扩建和改进不能倒写为启动当年的完成结果。

The 8 May 2024 startup release states up to 36,000 tCO₂/year nameplate capture, with 12 of 72 planned collectors then installed. Nameplate is not delivered net removal. Climate evaluation needs operation, energy emissions, storage and verification; later improvements are not backdated.

title: 有机催化：2021 年诺奖科学背景中的反应范围
Organocatalysis: reaction scopes in the 2021 Nobel scientific background
kind: 诺奖官方科学背景 · 历史汇总
Official Nobel scientific background · historical synthesis
body: 官方背景的印刷第 4 页、式 2 汇总脯氨酸催化 aldol 的 6 个示例：30 mol% 催化剂、54–97% 收率、er 80:20 至 98:2。数值对应图示底物范围，不是同一底物的一条最优记录。文件同时区分烯胺提高亲核性与亚胺离子提高亲电性的活化方式。

Printed page 4, equation 2 summarizes six proline-aldol examples: 30 mol% loading, 54–97% yields and 80:20–98:2 er. These are substrate-scope ranges, not a combined optimum for one substrate. Enamine and iminium activation are distinguished.
citation: Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, Enamine and iminium ion-mediated organocatalysis (2021)，印刷第 4 页式 2。
Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, Enamine and iminium ion-mediated organocatalysis (2021), printed p. 4, equation 2.

title: List、Lerner 与 Barbas：脯氨酸直接不对称 aldol
List, Lerner and Barbas: direct asymmetric proline aldol
body: 2000 年论文提出以 L-脯氨酸催化未预活化羰基底物的直接分子间 aldol。催化剂与底物可逆成键，形成参与碳—碳成键的烯胺。底物范围及分析须回到正文和补充材料；本页的范围数字另标明取自诺奖官方图示汇总。

The 2000 paper describes direct intermolecular aldol catalysis with L-proline and unmodified carbonyl substrates. Reversible catalyst–substrate bonding forms an enamine for C–C formation. Scope and analysis belong to the paper/SI; displayed scope numbers separately identify the Nobel summary.
citation: List, Lerner & Barbas III, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 122, 2395–2396 (2000). DOI: 10.1021/ja994280y。
List, Lerner & Barbas III, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 122, 2395–2396 (2000). DOI: 10.1021/ja994280y.

title: Ahrendt 等：首个高对映选择性有机催化 Diels–Alder
Ahrendt et al.: enantioselective organocatalytic Diels–Alder
kind: 原始研究 · 作者公开论文
body: 表 1 条目 5 以催化剂 7（5 mol%）使肉桂醛与环戊二烯反应：8 h、99% 收率、exo:endo 1.3:1，exo 产物 93% ee。正文另报告 50 mmol 制备得到 12 g、99% 收率与 exo 93% ee。93% ee 只属于所分析的 exo 组分，不表示非对映选择性很高。

Table 1 entry 5 uses catalyst 7 at 5 mol%: 8 h, 99% yield, 1.3:1 exo:endo and 93% ee for exo. A separate 50 mmol preparation gives 12 g, 99% yield and exo 93% ee. Exo ee is not the diastereomeric ratio.

title: Nicewicz／MacMillan：醛的不对称 α-烷基化
Nicewicz/MacMillan: asymmetric aldehyde α-alkylation
kind: 原始研究 · Science · 作者公开论文
body: 表 1 将 Ru(bpy)₃Cl₂ 光氧化还原与手性胺协同使用。条目 1 为辛醛和溴代丙二酸二乙酯体系，93% 收率、90% ee。图示通用条件是 20 mol% 有机催化剂、0.5 mol% Ru、15 W 荧光灯、DMF、23 °C；其他条目的例外依脚注保留。15 W 是灯泡额定功率，不是吸收光子通量或量子产率。

Table 1 combines Ru(bpy)₃Cl₂ photoredox with a chiral amine. Entry 1 gives 93% yield and 90% ee for octanal/diethyl bromomalonate. General conditions list 20 mol% organocatalyst, 0.5 mol% Ru, a 15 W lamp, DMF and 23 °C; exceptions remain in footnotes. Lamp wattage is not photon flux or quantum yield.

title: Rose Bengal：无过渡金属光氧化还原有机催化
Rose Bengal: transition-metal-free photoredox organocatalysis
body: 论文以 Rose Bengal 染料作为可见光敏化剂，配合咪唑烷酮有机催化剂和亲电助催化剂进行醛的直接对映选择性 α-烷基化。它提供了与 Ru 协同体系不同的催化组成；不能把 2008 年 Ru 体系的收率、ee 或光源参数移植到本体系。完整配方和具体底物结果见补充材料。

Rose Bengal acts as a visible-light sensitizer with an imidazolidinone and electrophilic cocatalyst for aldehyde α-alkylation. This differs from the Ru system; the earlier yields, ee and lighting conditions are not transferred. Full substrate-specific details are in the SI.
citation: Fidaly et al., Green Chem. 14, 1293–1297 (2012). DOI: 10.1039/C2GC35118H。

title: 点击反应：2022 年诺奖科学背景的条件与区域选择性
Click reactions: conditions and regioselectivity in the 2022 Nobel background
kind: 诺奖官方科学背景 · 历史汇总
Official Nobel scientific background · historical synthesis
body: 印刷第 6–7 页介绍早期 CuAAC 固相工作与溶液反应。早期会议工作的收率为 80–95%；图 6a 为固相末端炔与叠氮，Cu(I)、碱、THF、25 °C；图 6b 以 CuSO₄／抗坏血酸钠在水／叔丁醇、25 °C 生成 Cu(I)。这些条件分别对应不同示例。

Printed pp. 6–7 describe early solid-phase and solution CuAAC. The early conference work is summarized as 80–95% yield. Figure 6a uses Cu(I), base, THF and 25 °C; 6b uses CuSO₄/ascorbate in water/tert-butanol at 25 °C. These belong to distinct examples.

title: Tornøe 等：固相肽中的 CuAAC 三唑连接
Tornøe et al.: solid-phase CuAAC peptidotriazoles
kind: 原始研究 · Journal of Organic Chemistry
Original research · Journal of Organic Chemistry
body: 该研究以铜(I)催化末端炔和有机叠氮的区域专一环加成，在固相肽骨架或侧链构建 1,4-取代三唑。工作展示了多类叠氮底物及固相肽合成兼容性。区域选择性、分离收率和树脂负载效率是不同指标，应按各自条目分析。

This study uses Cu(I)-catalyzed regioselective terminal-alkyne/azide cycloaddition to build 1,4-substituted triazoles on peptide backbones or side chains. Substrate scope and solid-phase compatibility do not collapse regioselectivity, isolated yield and resin loading into one metric.
citation: Tornøe, Christensen & Meldal, J. Org. Chem. 67, 3057–3064 (2002). DOI: 10.1021/jo011148j。

title: Agard 等：应变促进的无铜叠氮—炔环加成
Agard et al.: strain-promoted copper-free cycloaddition
body: 该研究利用环辛炔的环张力，使其与叠氮在生理条件下发生环加成，无需铜催化剂。无铜消除了这一金属催化步骤，但不意味着所有探针对所有细胞都无毒；溶解性、背景反应和实际生物环境仍需逐项验证。

Cyclooctyne strain enables azide cycloaddition under physiological conditions without a copper catalyst. Removing copper does not establish universal probe compatibility; solubility, background reactivity and biological context remain relevant.
citation: Agard, Prescher & Bertozzi, JACS 126, 15046–15047 (2004). DOI: 10.1021/ja044996f。

title: Baskin 等：无铜点击用于活细胞动态成像
Baskin et al.: copper-free click for dynamic live-cell imaging
body: 研究将改造的环辛炔探针用于活体系中叠氮标记糖链的快速、选择性显影。选择性标签的化学反应与检测信号需要分开理解：荧光强度同时受探针进入、洗涤、背景和成像设置影响，不能直接等同于化学收率。

Modified cyclooctyne probes label azide-bearing glycans in living systems. Chemical ligation and imaging readout differ: fluorescence depends on access, washing, background and acquisition, not solely reaction yield.

title: Tournier 等：工程化 PET 水解酶与单体回收
Tournier et al.: engineered PET hydrolase and monomer recovery
body: 论文摘要报告 10 h 内至少 90% PET 解聚，生产率为 16.7 g 对苯二甲酸类产物·L⁻¹·h⁻¹；条件包括 200 g PET/kg 悬浮液及 3 mg 酶/g PET。该指标针对预处理废 PET 体系，不是任意聚合物或自然环境中的降解速率。正文进一步展示单体回收后的 PET 再合成。

The abstract reports at least 90% PET depolymerization over 10 h and 16.7 g terephthalate·L⁻¹·h⁻¹, at 200 g PET/kg suspension and 3 mg enzyme/g PET. This concerns the studied PET system, not arbitrary polymers or environmental degradation, and includes repolymerization from recovered monomers.

title: Lu 等：FAST-PETase 的底物范围与预处理
Lu et al.: FAST-PETase scope and pretreatment
body: FAST-PETase 在 30–50 °C 显示活性改善，论文测试的 51 种未经处理的消费后热成型 PET 产品可在一周内近乎完全解聚。商业水瓶的无定形部分与经热处理的整个水瓶在 50 °C 下另行研究。不同材料形态和预处理不能合并为“所有 PET 一周内全部分解”。

FAST-PETase improves activity across 30–50 °C. The 51 tested untreated post-consumer thermoformed PET products nearly fully depolymerize within a week. Bottle amorphous regions and a thermally pretreated whole bottle are studied separately at 50 °C; this is not a universal PET claim.

title: CARBIOS：Longlaville 工厂开工时的设计能力

title: CARBIOS：2024 可持续发展报告中的项目暂停记录
CARBIOS: project suspension recorded in the 2024 sustainability report
kind: 企业年度报告 · 指定历史版本
body: 该报告记录 2024 年 12 月因需要进一步融资而暂时暂停 Longlaville 建设。它补充了早期开工公告的后续历史，说明开工、设计能力、建设状态与稳定运行必须分别核对；此条不被表述为 2026 年最新施工状态。
